children.text: Antara Bubuya brings playful storytelling to Genting SkyWorlds, one of Malaysia’s busiest theme park destinations. We created the campaign’s key visuals and animated screen content.
The campaign had to work as a printed promotional panel and as an animated event screen inside a high-traffic attraction — the same story, told at very different sizes.
We built a reusable visual system with layered motion elements and scalable composition rules, so every placement keeps its charm whatever the ratio.
Campaign timing was tight, so asset consistency and quick revision cycles mattered as much as the artwork. Modular layers let us adapt a placement in hours rather than days.
That kept the collaboration between the brand and venue teams moving, which on a live campaign is most of the job.
